title: Customer Success Manager, Scale

description:
Who we are 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 
 About the role: 
 Samsara’s Customer Success team is on the front lines of business value delivery by helping customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. As a Scaled Customer Success Manager on the Commercial team, you will manage a high volume of accounts once onboarding is complete. You will support requests but also proactively identify growth opportunities and risk throughout the customer lifecycle in order to prioritize outreach.
 This is a highly impactful role as you execute and improve scaled programs to not only impact one customer at a time but hundreds to thousands. You’ll be transforming the way customers uncover value with Samsara both by using AI and one-to-many programs to drive success.
 This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.  
 You should apply if: 
 You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely at school, or whether power is restored quickly after a natural disaster.
 You thrive most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities our customers face provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
 You’re technical and curious: You’re comfortable getting hands-on with integrations, APIs, and complex product configurations — and you enjoy diagnosing technical challenges to find the right solution for a customer.
 You are a natural relationship builder: whether with our customers or cross-functional teams at Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
 You want to build, not just operate: This team is still shaping its future. You’ll have the autonomy to help build the next chapter of Mid-Market CS at Samsara, leveraging AI to do the best work of your career.
 You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals.
 In this role, you will:   
 Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our AI-powered IoT platform.
 Manage a high volume portfolio of accounts, monitoring customer health, growth, and risk signals at scale to prioritize and improve retention.
 Help build the next chapter of scalable CS at Samsara by contributing to the playbooks, workflows, and AI-powered motions that define how the team operates.
 Conduct workshops, webinars, office hours, and other scalable motions with customers to support the growth and adoption in their journey.
 Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities — including its more technical and integration-related features — to explain technical solutions to a non-technical audience.
 Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.
 Minimum requirements for the role: 
 2 – 4+ years of experience in a customer success, account management, sales, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred.
 This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong prioritization and high emotional intelligence.
 Possesses a strong bias for action with a customer-centric approach.
 Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills.
 Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders: executives, Sales, Product, Support, and Engineering leadership, and day-to-day users of our software.
 Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, being inquisitive and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.
 Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.
 Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution.

 Experience supporting a high-volume book of business, working towards retention and growth goals.

title: Partner Enablement Manager
location: San Francisco, CA / Boston, MA United States
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.





This role is preferred office-based to support in-person mentorship and collaboration across internal and partner teams. We’re also open to Benchling employees who are currently remote.




ROLE OVERVIEW

Benchling is looking for a Partner Enablement Manager to help our implementation partners deliver Benchling in pharmaceutical and life science accounts.

You'll train partners in live and virtual sessions, help run partner certification, and observe and coach partners on real projects. You'll bring what you learn back to the CX Enablement team so we can improve our courses. When it works, partners are ready faster, customers go live with confidence no matter who implements, and fewer partner-caused issues reach Support and Professional Services.

This role is a step into enablement for someone who already has experience with Benchling and enjoys teaching others (for example by walking customers through issues, writing knowledge articles, or onboarding new teammates.) You'll work with CX Enablement, Professional Services, Product, the Partners team, and with partner organizations directly. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Train partners directly through live and virtual sessions, such as onboarding cohorts, workshops, and product deep dives, for both subcontracted and direct partner delivery teams

 - Help administer partner certification, including tracking progress and supporting partners through it

 - Gather feedback from partners on where their teams struggle, and work through it with the rest of the CX Enablement team to decide what to improve or build

 - Build partner-specific coursework where it’s needed, and work with the CX Enablement team to bring it into certification pathways

 - Support Professional Services in running subcontracted and direct partner programs by tracking partner readiness and flagging risks early

 - Observe partners on real work, give feedback, and coach them directly on improvements

 - Help prepare partners for new product releases, working with Product and CX Enablement so partners are ready alongside internal teams

 - Report on defined partner readiness measures, such as time to certification and partner-caused support issues, to the enablement team and Professional Services leadership

 


QUALIFICATIONS

Required

 - Experience teaching Benchling to others, such as through customer calls, escalations, knowledge articles, or onboarding new teammates

 - Hands-on experience supporting or implementing Benchling, with a deep working knowledge of the platform

 - Comfortable presenting to technical and scientific audiences, or eager to build this skill with coaching

 - Experience giving direct, constructive feedback, such as through case reviews, shadowing, or mentoring

 - Experience turning recurring questions or feedback into clear written content, such as help articles or runbooks

 - Experience working across teams like Product, Engineering, or Professional Services to resolve issues

 - BS or M.Sc. in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Genetics, or similar life science field

Nice to have

 - Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) practice: capturing and improving knowledge articles as part of solving issues

 - Experience working with outside partners, consultants, or implementation teams

 - A scientific background, through a life science degree or work in scientific settings

 - Experience using data to show whether training worked

 


HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).



Benchling welcomes everyone.

We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences. 

We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

 Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.
 We’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.

 Lead one of our highest-performing enterprise teams as it shows customers why a Predictive Revenue System is the way to run pipeline, forecast and growth.

At Salesloft, we connect pipeline generation, deal progression and forecasting in one closed loop through our Predictive Revenue System, and you’ll help your team bring that story to senior revenue and technology leaders.  Keep a strong team on the field: assess the talent, decide where to upskill and where to add, and keep the team’s momentum through a rapidly changing market.

 A record of leading enterprise teams to results: Consistent quota attainment across 5+ years of leading enterprise sellers, with a team where several reps reach top-performer status.
 Hands-on leadership of complex deals: You’ve guided large, multi-stakeholder deals (six to seven figures) through renewal and expansion, and know how to add value in the room without taking over from the rep.

 You’ll lead 6 to 8 seasoned enterprise sellers on one of the strongest teams in our enterprise segment, with several already at or pacing toward President’s Club.  This is not a traditional reporting or martech administration role. Your primary value will be your ability to frame ambiguous business questions, diagnose the underlying drivers of performance, distinguish signal from noise, and help cross-functional teams make better operating and investment decisions. 
 You will also be expected to use AI and automation extensively to reduce repetitive analytical work, accelerate insight generation, and spend more time on interpretation, problem solving, and decision support.

 Own analysis of the Marketing-to-Revenue funnel from engagement and qualification through pipeline progression and revenue.

 Build clear analyses and reporting that surface meaningful trends, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
 Collaborate with cross-functional partners to i mprove lifecycle definitions, lead scoring, routing, SLAs, and measurement frameworks where funnel analysis identifies opportunities. 
 Partner with Marketing SLG, RevOps, SDR, Sales, Analytics, and Systems teams to resolve cross-functional funnel and data-quality issues.
 Use AI and automation to accelerate query development, recurring reporting, anomaly detection, synthesis, and first-pass insight generation while remaining accountable for validation and final recommendations.

 Experience analyzing B2B marketing and sales funnels from marketing engagement through pipeline and revenue. 
 Strong analytical judgment and demonstrated ability to diagnose ambiguous business or funnel-performance problems. 
 Experience working with Salesforce data and familiarity with Marketo or another B2B marketing automation platform. 
 Experience using BI or analytics tools to explore, measure, and communicate funnel performance. 
 Working knowledge of SQL or sufficient fluency to independently inspect and analyze structured data. 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority. 
 Experience translating analysis into clear recommendations and business actions rather than stopping at reporting. 
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience working within Revenue Operations or in a highly integrated Marketing and RevOps environment. 
 Experience partnering directly with Demand Generation, Marketing Operations, Data Science, SDR, and Sales teams. 
 Experience improving lead scoring, lifecycle stages, routing, SLAs, attribution, or funnel measurement. 
 Experience building reusable analytical frameworks or standardized operating metrics. 
 Experience using AI tools to improve analytical workflows while maintaining strong validation and quality controls.

 Awareness: U nderstand yourself and others .

 Anthropic is building AI systems that will shape the trajectory of one of the most consequential technologies in human history.
